1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.
142/2021, under Sections 419/420/120B of the IPC, registered at P.S. Crime Branch.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the applicant is at liberty to place on record copy of the order granting anticipatory bail to co-accused in the present FIR.
